stories.h: Nightly I-5 lane, ramp closures in Kent-Federal Way this week
stories.s: Starting tonight through Friday morning, up to four southbound I-5 lanes close 9 p.m.-6 a.m. between SR 516 and S. 272nd St., with ramp closures and detours, for SR 509 project work.

stories.h: Sea-Tac flight disruptions ease after nationwide ground stop
stories.s: Cancellations at Sea-Tac fell to a few dozen Sunday morning, down from 130-plus Saturday. Airlines aimed to restore full schedules; travelers should still confirm flights with their airline.

stories.h: Power problem near Tukwila halted Link 1 Line Sunday
stories.s: A power issue near Tukwila station shut the 1 Line Sunday morning, with shuttle buses running between Kent Des Moines and Rainier Beach. Sound Transit now lists the disruption as resolved.

stories.h: Redmond shooting leaves one dead; two suspects sought
stories.s: One person died after a Friday afternoon shooting on Avondale Road NE in Redmond. Two suspects fled; police say they don't believe the public is at risk and are seeking tips.

coming.s: Seattle City Council is set to take its final vote on the 2027-28 budget, which closes a $175 million deficit, after committee votes on amendments.
